rationale: The two-stage fact parser checks unique declarations and explicit assignments, constructor arity, target existence, variable-store cardinality, supported slot projections, and array bounds. edge_target resolves named fields or indices; the final lease pass requires an initialized owned/leased edge, allowing forward references but rejecting a shared or missing support. Boundary tests exercise arrays of length zero and 64, reject 65 and out-of-bounds assignment, and preserve every empty slot. Invalid-fact tests cover unknown nodes, duplicate slots, primitive projection, and variable-store targets. Ownership cycles and conflicting owners are intentionally outside these structural checks.
